user.description:
Folders-HA is an unofficial open-source hobby project. It is not made, endorsed or supported by folders.nl or any store.

Folders follows every store on folders.nl, also stores that join later. Leave out what you do not want, or select Submit to follow them all. You can change this later, and add words to watch for in the Watch list.
